page.overview:
What is Weeping Vines?

Weeping vines are climbable downwards-growing vegetation blocks found in the Nether in crimson forests.

Weeping vines can be broken instantly using any tool. They have a 33% chance to drop a single weeping vine when broken, increased to 55% with Fortune I, 77% with Fortune II, and 100% with Fortune III. They always drop a single weeping vine when broken using shears or a tool enchanted with Silk Touch. Any segments left unsupported from above break with a 33% drop chance, regardless of the tool used. Accordingly, weeping vines are best harvested starting from the bottommost block up.

Weeping vines generate naturally inside crevices within the ceilings, or on huge crimson fungi in the crimson forest biome.

A huge fungus grown by bone meal on a crimson fungus generates weeping vines growing on it.
